summary: Machine Payment Endpoint Preflight: Inspect one public HTTPS endpoint without credentials or payment. Validate the URL, make one bounded GET request, and report whether its HTTP 402 x402 or MPP payment offers are parseable and internally consistent. Return protocols, prices, currencies, networks, recipients, expiries, conflicts, and a safe next action. Never sign, pay, or broadcast a transaction. Use when an agent needs to run this published AgentPMT workflow with 2 linked tool skills, workflow.
